title: Questions and troubleshooting
summary: Quick answers to common questions and what to do when something does not work.

items: Check the email address and password. Press the eye icon to see what you typed.
Press **Forgot password?** to set a new one.
After too many wrong attempts the app waits a few minutes. Try again later.
Lost your phone or recovery codes? Ask your administrator to reset your two-step verification.
Your invitation link may have expired. Ask for a new invitation.

sections.title: I do not see a part of the app, or it says I have no access

blocks.text: The administrator decides what each person can open. Ask them to check your permissions. See [Who can see what](who-sees-what).

sections.title: The app keeps asking me to confirm it's you

blocks.text: For Health and Finances, the app asks again after a period of inactivity, and before sensitive actions. This protects your family's private data. See [Confirm it's you](account-security#confirm).

items: Open [Settings > Notifications](/settings/notifications) and check that email or push is on.
A task needs a due date for a reminder.
For push, enable it on each device. On iPhone and iPad install the app on the Home Screen first.
If your browser blocked notifications, allow them in the browser settings for this site.
Look in your spam folder for email reminders.

sections.title: Why can I not see who reserved my wish?

blocks.text: To keep gifts a surprise. See [Why you never see who reserved your own wishes](wishlist#surprise).

sections.title: A document or image will not upload

items: Health documents: use PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 10 MB each.
Wishlist images: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
Bank files for import: .csv or .txt, up to 2 MB.
If a file cannot be read, save it again from the original program and try the new copy.

sections.title: The app says I am offline

blocks.text: FamilyHUB needs a connection to show and save your data. When your device is offline, a banner appears. Your changes are not saved until you are back online, so wait for the banner to disappear before you rely on a change.

sections.title: A message says a new version is available

blocks.text: Press **Reload** in the message. The page restarts with the newest version. Finish what you are typing and save it first.

sections.title: The app icon still shows the old logo

blocks.text: After the update, browsers show the new FamilyHUB logo, but an app that is already installed on a device can keep its old icon for a while.

items: **Android:** the icon updates by itself, usually within a day.
**iPhone and iPad:** press and hold the old icon, remove it from the Home Screen, then add the app again from Safari (see **Putting the app on your phone, tablet or computer**).
**Computer:** the icon updates by itself; if not, uninstall the app from the browser menu and install it again.

blocks.text: Removing the icon does not delete anything. Your family's data stays on the server.
